applicability.reason: The accepted R5a increment requires actual failure producers, one canonical typed-source catalog, durable human-correctable investigations and bounded grouping in the existing dashboard. Original criteria and downstream integration obligations remain intact.

entries.contract: R1 operation facts retain their IDs. Actual ContractError is captured before dispatch stringification or after authenticated assignment validation. Observation finish owns publication; policy audit uses its caller connection with nullable denied attempt and eight-value inserts. No fabricated AL policy event or measured budget detail.

Both AL distributions publish closed immutable terminal-result references before matching outbox assembly and accepted review references from the validated raw snapshot/save seam. Preserve original/reconciliation observations, actual issuing identity and stable result identity on validity-only changes.

Bounded worker replay prepares exact immutable buffers from server-selected issuing roots/indexes outside the ingest transaction. Event, typed catalog/source rows, projection, timeline and cursor commit atomically under current epoch, binding, sequence and replay checks.

Existing scoped dashboard reads and local operator POST authority consume canonical incidents for search, provenance, append-only investigation and bounded grouping. Explicit request/revision projection preserves old R1 identities and late unindexed rows; GET remains readonly.

Known future integrations are actual R6 candidate generation from the canonical catalog, R7 committed evaluation-result adaptation and separately designed R5b standalone collection. Their ownership and required contracts are resolved; execution of those integrations remains pending and is not represented as implemented or verified.

consumer_inventory.reason: The three actual recorded discovery reports identify current producers, consumers, transaction owners, compatibility behavior and named future integrations. Their content was read, and all 24 current production hashes in the latest prevalidation were recomputed and matched. Consumer identity discovery is resolved; final test/coverage and future integration evidence remains explicitly pending in the outcomes and specification, not hidden as a pass.

items.description: Existing R1 operation-only incidents and observations are persisted; policy decisions use eight columns and nullable denied attempts. No canonical non-operation catalog or dedicated ContractError receipt exists.
A current Harness-bound execution has an authenticated AL issuing root and a real terminal ledger entry, accepted review snapshot, typed boundary rejection or policy denial ready for publication.
Canonical incidents have typed source relations and an optional current investigation/group revision. Their observations, findings and human reports are distinct.
Old immutable bridges can insert legacy-only incidents, including rows arriving after an empty projection batch with older timestamps.
The execution is terminal or its prior epoch is superseded. Historical operator reporting remains possible through operator authority; old runtime callbacks lack mutation authority.
Standalone AL output has actual AL provenance without a fabricated Harness binding; known R6/R7/R5b integrations have not yet supplied their required execution evidence.

reset.reason: There is no destructive reset. Corrections and group decisions append interpretations; source facts, original observations, pins, approvals and runtime liabilities remain intact.

items.action: Apply additive schema-only changes in disposable storage. Preserve R1 tables/IDs and eight-column policy decisions; create canonical/source/investigation/request structures without historical copying.

Through real guarded save, prepare a closed immutable terminal-entry receipt before matching outbox assembly. Preserve original terminal and reconciliation companions; reuse stable result identity for later validity-only observations rather than creating another failure.

At cmd_report, validate actual packet/attempt/report, snapshot accepted raw bytes, then publish a closed finding reference during the same guarded save. Preserve stable finding/report identity and attributed finding semantics.

Resolve server-selected issuing-root/index references and read bounded bytes once before the transaction. Validate exact source/event binding, then use those prepared buffers within ingest_event's current-epoch transaction to atomically insert event, typed catalog/source rows, projection, timeline and cursor. No subprocess or separate writer belongs inside it.

At audit(conn, execution, intent, verdict, code, digest), add the policy incident/source using the caller connection. Preserve denied attempt NULL and positional inserts. Optional pool/dimension details come only from actual typed rejecting checks in a sidecar; unsupported accounting is not fabricated exhaustion.

Detect actual ContractError before dispatch stringification; inside finish's owned publication insert its closed receipt/catalog relation through internal connection-taking helpers. Assignment-wait rejection publishes separately after validation unwinds with fresh authority checks. Preserve actual setup owner and generic-error classification.

Use existing local operator POST authority with bounded content, actual scope, request ID and expected revision to append an attributed historical verdict or correction. Keep source facts, hypotheses, ordinal confidence, controls and resolution rationale distinct; do not use stale runtime publication.

Compute reproducible bounded related-incident suggestions from safe canonical facts and persist authorized accept/reject/split decisions with revision checks, without merging or deleting source incidents.

An explicit operator request selects at most 100 currently unindexed scoped R1 rows, preserves their identities and atomically records projection/checkpoint/request receipt. Exact replay returns the prior result; a new request searches remaining unindexed rows again, including late/backdated old-pin inserts.
Scoped API/dashboard reads use identity-preserving catalog/legacy UNION with NOT EXISTS, stable pagination and provenance navigation. GET causes no projection, import, execution or other mutation.

Preserve real standalone AL identities and explicit collection limits. Keep actual R6 catalog consumption, R7 evaluation adaptation and R5b ingestion as pending integration work, and final required checks/hosted CI/native/browser qualification as unexecuted until recorded. Do not claim completion from fixtures, check purpose or schema presence.

transitions.reason: These are concrete additions at inspected source seams using established current-epoch, immutable artifact and request/revision transaction patterns. No new cross-store or execution-authority protocol is introduced in R5a.

specification.reason: The full original mission, accepted R5a criteria and retained source-corrected plans are implementable without a new material developer decision. The actual fresh packet is bound to the existing run and source observation. All 24 production hashes in the latest source prevalidation were recomputed and matched; the three real consumer-discovery artifacts were read and supplied using the accepted immutable reference shape. Existing consumers and named future integrations are resolved, so consumer_inventory.uncertainties is empty; this does not erase pending execution evidence. The actual remaining additions are immutable terminal receipts before matching outbox assembly, accepted-review source publication, typed ContractError capture before stringification, same-transaction canonical insertion, operator investigation/grouping and bounded legacy projection. Observation finish owns its publication; policy audit uses the caller connection and preserves null attempts/eight-value inserts; event evidence is prepared from exact issuing-root buffers before ingestion's transaction. R4 reconciliation, historical plan/escalation observations and decision-only authenticated delivery receipts retain their precise scope. These established patterns justify STANDARD, no Designer, with Engineer then useful Builder sequentially. The prior refused report and upstream source changes remain history and external attribution; this report claims neither admission nor executed proof. Actual R6 candidate consumption under R5a-10, R7 evaluation adaptation, R5b standalone collection, final required-check evidence, applicable hosted CI, native/provider qualification and functional/visual browser verification remain explicit obligations until genuinely performed. No service, test, DB operation, native/authentication activity, file edit or new approval was performed or invented. Defined implementation is not gated on a blanket Knowledge acceptance or generic user permission.
